newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Aziz calls for lifting of oil embargo.
newsitem.headline: Aziz calls for lifting of oil embargo.

text.p: Iraq's Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz called on Friday for the lifting of the U.N.-imposed economic ban on his country, but said Washington would do its utmost to maintain the global oil embargo.

"We are hoping by the end of this year that the security council will consider lifting the sanctions," he told reporters during an official visit to Brussels at the invitation of a group of peace lobbyists.
Aziz accused Washington of opposing his country's recent oil-for-food deal with the United Nations which allows Iraq to sell $2 billion worth of oil over six months.
Aziz said Iraq had only received some 10 percent of the monies owed to it under the deal.

"There is a lack of equilibrium between what is in the interests of the United Nations and what is in the interests of Iraq," he said, adding Washington would oppose any further relaxation of sanctions "at any rate".
